name: snapshots_list
description: List saved Session Snapshots and their IDs without changing them.

name: snapshots_read
description: Read one saved Session Snapshot by ID.

name: snapshots_apply
description: Restore a saved workbench snapshot, creating the same backup pill as the Apply button. Read the summary aloud and wait for Kev’s yes before confirmed true.

name: snapshots_add_note
description: Append a note to a saved snapshot. Read the summary aloud and wait for Kev’s yes before confirmed true.

name: plugin_tags_read
description: Read saved Plugins tags and their scanned product memberships.

name: plugin_tag_set
description: Replace the tags on one exact scanned product. Supply id from plugin_tags_read or exact name and publisher. Read the summary aloud and wait for Kev’s yes before confirmed true.

name: hidden_list
description: List plug-ins hidden from the main Plugins library.

name: plugin_hide
description: Hide or show one scanned plug-in by product id. Read the summary aloud and wait for Kev’s yes before confirmed true.

name: reference_status
description: Read Mix Check reference capture and selected target status. Loading an audio file remains manual through the browser file picker.

name: saved_targets_list
description: List saved Mix Check reference targets.

name: saved_target_apply
description: Select one saved Mix Check reference target. Read the summary aloud and wait for Kev’s yes before confirmed true.

name: mixbus_load_preset
description: Replace the relevant MixBus chain with a saved or built-in preset matched by exact name. Read the summary aloud and wait for Kev’s yes before confirmed true.

name: mixbus_auto_fill
description: Run the existing MixBus Auto-fill settings action. Read the summary aloud and wait for Kev’s yes before confirmed true.

name: settings_status
description: Read provider configured booleans, ElevenLabs credits used, limit and remaining per account, selected models, and companion status. Never returns keys, tokens, agent IDs or secret values. Settings cannot be opened or changed through this tool.

name: vocal_favorites_read
description: Read matching chain favourites from the video report. For a requested bus choose its chain, prefer owned, then close versions, equivalents and Logic stock; say which video plug-in was swapped.

section.description: Section to read; defaults to all.

name: vocal_favorites_apply
description: Prepare or apply matching chain favourites. First call with confirmed false, read the exact counts aloud, get Kev’s clear yes, then call with confirmed true. Returns verified starred, already and unresolved counts.

names.description: Exact item names to apply; omit for the whole chain view.

confirmed.description: True only after Kev clearly confirms the proposed count.
